wavelength_normalization_instructions:
Parse wavelength/frequency descriptions and output in simple text format.
⚠️ CRITICAL: Return ONLY the wavelength values and unit in simple text format. No JSON, no explanations.
Scope: This is the instrument’s observing band (photon wavelength/energy/frequency). If the text is about temporal signals or metadata (e.g., p-mode oscillation frequencies, cadence, exposure times, oscillation periods), return "not_applicable".
Qualitative band names without numbers: If the text mentions a band name but gives no numeric bounds (e.g., Soft X-ray, Hard X-ray, generic “X-ray”, “white light”/visible), return "not_applicable" rather than inventing a range. Only emit numeric ranges when explicit numbers or well-known line names are present.
Specific lines: For Lyα/Lyman-alpha, use 1215.67 angstrom (do not round to 1216).
Format rules: - For single values: "123 nm" - For multiple discrete values: "211 angstrom, 193 angstrom" - For ranges: "1-8 angstrom" - If wavelength cannot be determined: "not_applicable"
Unit names must be: angstrom, nm, keV, kHz, MHz, GHz, Hz, or "not_applicable"
⚠️ Do NOT include any other text, explanations, or commentary.
"211 Å and 193 Å" 211 angstrom, 193 angstrom
"7155 MHz" 7155 MHz
"1-8 Å" 1-8 angstrom
"Not specified" not_applicable
"10 keV, 20 keV, 30 keV" 10 keV, 20 keV, 30 keV
"0.5-2.5 GHz" 0.5-2.5 GHz
"p-mode frequency domain emphasized: between 1.4 and 3.7 mHz" not_applicable
"1 min cadence observations" not_applicable
"Soft X-ray imaging" not_applicable
"White-light" not_applicable
"Visible-light" not_applicable
"X-ray spectroscopy; 1/3 keV bins <25 keV; analysis of high-energy tail >10 keV" 0.333 keV, 10 keV, 25 keV
"Lyα" 1215.67 angstrom
Return ONLY the wavelength values and unit. Nothing else.
